title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 22 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.
AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We attach two fixed-price packages. Both commit 23700 kg a year to you, for 24 or 36 months. That gives your planning a secure volume without surcharge administration.

Which package suits you better? What is the earliest lead time you can confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified the recent decreases in AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 and have adjusted our price to €5.30 accordingly.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

While we welcome the 24-month volume commitment, we cannot offer a fixed price over this duration and must apply an AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. In response to your inquiry, our standard lead time for this material is four weeks from order confirmation.

Our updated offer provides a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Part:370010 – fixed-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We have moved our fixed-price package. It commits 23700 kg a year to you for 24 months, with payment at 60 days. A fixed price spares both sides the monthly surcharge calculation and the related administration, while the volume gives you the base you focus on.

Is there a cheaper variant, for example in delivery batching, that would help you reach it?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 – fixed-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We must maintain the AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month contract term. In response to your question about delivery batching, our production is already optimized, meaning alternative delivery variants do not offer further savings. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and the cost-saving ideas.

On volume: our package commits 23700 kg per year to you for 24 months, a total of 47400 kg, with payment at 60 days. That is our full yearly need for this bar.

We have moved our fixed-price package another step toward you. A fixed price removes the monthly surcharge calculation and the matching administration on both sides. The firm two-year volume gives your planning the base you focus on.

You mentioned in our annual review that larger price changes go to your pricing committee.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for relying on Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We appreciate the firm commitment of 23,700 kg per year for 24 months, which provides a solid basis for our planning. 

However, as previously stated, we cannot offer a fixed price over a two-year period and must maintain the AS-14404 index clause. In recognition of your movement and the volume commitment, we have adjusted our price to €5.00 per unit.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot features a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer is valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
